positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Create new automation for our Desktop applications using Swift and C#.  
- Setup cycles to run nightly, on new builds and patches using Jenkins.  
- Maintain current automation and update when necessary.  
- Resolve bugs found by automation.
- Help the QA team as needed.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
- Responsible for new features and regression testing.
- Write new test cases and update the test cases already written to maintain our testing session are accurate.
- Build and maintain automation scripts using python to run endurance, repetitive, and health reports.
- Responsible to gather field testing, automated testings, and regression testing data and reporting that to my managers.
